page-parsed.eventDescription: One successfully parsed Pinterest search page: $8 per 1,000 checks. Charged even when filters, exclusions, duplicates or monitoring leave zero rows. Failed/unrecognized responses and invalid input are not charged. A separate delivered-row fee applies. No start fee; compute included. No extra source account or API key. Work stops before a new check when the Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd cannot cover that check plus one row.

pin.eventDescription: One delivered pin row: $1 per 1,000 rows. Row keys: query, title, image_url, image_orientation, destination_domain, destination_url, board_name, created_at. Filtered, duplicate, excluded and unchanged rows are not charged. Successful source checks are separately billed at $0.008 each, including empty checks. No start fee; compute included. maxTotalChargeUsd is an Apify run option, not input.
